description: Defines the CatalogItem class representing an item in the catalog with properties like Id, Name, Description, Price, and image data. Includes methods for validating images and converting files to Base64.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item with properties including ID, type, brand, name, description, price, and image data. Also contains static methods for image validation and file conversion.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates the image file based on name and Base64 data, checking size limits and extension validity.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts an uploaded file to a Base64 string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is among allowed image formats.
